name: Grand rivet driver
description: A pneumatic driver the length of a bridge, firing iron slugs the size of a small cart. It is loud and slow, and it hits like a falling roof.

name: Anvil gun
description: The great gun of a Hold League warship. The yard says it is not for hitting things so much as for ending arguments.

name: Cinder cannon
description: Lobs slow balls of glowing slag that cling to armour and keep burning.

name: Forgemouth cannon
description: A furnace with a barrel on the front. It throws a ball of white-hot plasma a long way, if not quickly.

name: Hailstone battery
description: A rattling bank of short barrels that fills the air with bursting gravel. Nothing small gets through it.

name: Hammerfall torpedo
description: A very heavy homing warhead in a thick iron casing. It is slow, and it is meant to be.

name: Pebble rack
description: A little iron rack of homing missiles, tough enough to be fitted to a fighter and ignored.

name: Cairn rack
description: Two heavier missiles in a riveted cradle. They are slow to turn but they arrive with a good deal of iron.
